# L08: How to make $100k a month with content in 2026

Tristan Workman with Briar Cochran · youtube · https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6Zk5XPNHZY4 · notes: [lessons/08_tristan-workman-100k-content.md](../../brain/lessons/08_tristan-workman-100k-content.md)

**Core lesson:** Treat content as testable marketing: untangle each video into hook, format, topic and illustration, protect follower quality, run a 4:2:1 weekly funnel mix and follow up with every lead.


## Ideas from this source (54)

- **[Don't overthink: say something crazy](../topics/hooks.md#hook-say-something-crazy)** · hooks: Briar's hook philosophy: don't think about hooks too much; say something crazy and get into it. He also says a great hook is harder to teach.
- **[Cold open with later highlights](../topics/hooks.md#hook-cold-open-montage)** · hooks: Long conversations open on a montage of their best later moments: L08 a 46 s teaser of its most contrarian line; L09 about 50 s of highlights starting with an interactive game.
- **[Conflict and a shared enemy](../topics/story.md#story-conflict-everywhere)** · story: Build every example on conflict: before/after, problem/solution, an enemy (A = approach, B = belief, C = competitor), juxtaposition. Tristan: a shared enemy is one of the best copywriting principles.
- **[Open loops, re-open one at ~15 s](../topics/story.md#story-open-loops)** · story: Open curiosity at the start and keep opening loops with illustrations, metaphors and stats. Viewers who got the point 15 s in leave, so re-open a new loop around 15 s; a spoken "Why?" works. Caleb wants editors who "open and close loops".
- **[Statement, reason, re-hook, "Why?", payoff](../topics/story.md#story-live-hook-build)** · story: Briar's live script: strong statement, a one-sentence reason (so people aren't annoyed), a stronger re-hook with high stakes, "Why?" to open the next loop, the payoff, then a wild closing line as a comment driver.
- **[Even "here's three things" beats no frame](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-any-framework-beats-none)** · ideas: Tristan: even a cringey "here's three things" does better than no framework; Briar lists "9 travel hacks" as a valid reach post while calling it "kind of cringe".
- **[Idea faucets: Reddit and your own winners](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-reddit-faucet)** · ideas: Sort your niche subreddit by top of the month and have ChatGPT summarise what people discuss; and turn last week's most viral video into one specific buzzword ("creative tax strategies") for next week's video.
- **[Copy only true outliers](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-outliers-vs-own-average)** · ideas: A video is an outlier only against that creator's own average (20K isn't an outlier if they average 100K). Briar keeps a second TikTok account that follows only the niche; Oren's library sorts by ≥2× outliers.
- **[5 in-niche for topics, 5 outside for packaging](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-5-plus-5-creators)** · ideas: Take topics from 5 niche competitors and packaging (formats, camera angles, series) from 5 creators outside the niche; nobody knows where your combos come from.
- **[Green or red, never grey](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-polarise-green-red)** · ideas: Take a hard stance you actually believe about 90% of the time; keep nuance for private work. People who disagree argue in the comments, which drives reach.
- **[Widen the audience one layer higher](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-high-tam-one-layer-up)** · ideas: For top-of-funnel reach, widen the audience one layer ("college girls that love Pilates" → "ladies"; sales → business → money → ambition) and avoid narrowing words like "business owners", but keep a through-line to what you do.
- **[Pick one goal: comments, sends or saves](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-conversation-goal)** · ideas: Decide whether a video is for comments, sends (communal language like "me and the boys after we ___") or saves; you usually can't hit all of them.
- **[Comment farm: plant an odd detail](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-comment-farm)** · ideas: Plant something odd in frame that people will comment on (an open Birkin bag on a NYC walk, a visible laptop tab, a bag on a car roof), or ride a hot news topic and tie it to your niche.
- **[AI prompt: unique, specific, observed](../topics/ai-tools.md#ideas-unique-specific-observed)** · ai-tools: Use AI for ideation: ask for the most unique, specific and observed situation your ideal viewer has lived. Name the problem nobody has named (Briar's "follower quality" drew "Finally, someone's talking about…").
- **[14 topics, then reformat them](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-14-topics-reformatted)** · ideas: Briar's local-business tier: 14 topics for two weeks, then the same topics reformatted (green screen → whiteboard → talking head → podcast style) for the next two; weaker feedback loop.
- **[Formats working in Dec 2025](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-green-screen-beginners)** · ideas: Briar: green screen with one image behind you for beginners; the clone format (talking to yourself) about to be overplayed; livestreams for educators as a "baked-in webinar".
- **[Sell a long video with a hyper-edited teaser](../topics/editing.md#edit-teaser-hyper-edited)** · editing: L08's 46 s teaser of its single most contrarian soundbite: shots 0.8–1.8 s, 10–15% push-ins/outs, screen flashes, speed ramps on percussive hits, bass drops on text pops, ending on a metallic thud and hard cut to black.
- **[Speed ramps: dead time, beats, top rep](../topics/editing.md#edit-speed-ramps)** · editing: Subtle ramps on browser scrolls and screen recordings remove dead time (L07); the L08 teaser syncs ramps to percussive hits; our gym default ramps into the top rep.
- **[Podcast body: long takes, demos as interrupts](../topics/editing.md#edit-podcast-long-takes)** · editing: The L08 podcast body is a wide multi-cam master with long uncut takes, dialogue only (no music bed or SFX); pattern interrupts come from live demos. Only the teaser is scored.
- **[SFX meanings: whoosh, pop, chime, thud](../topics/sound.md#sound-sfx-meaning-map)** · sound: Whoosh for movement (slides, wipes, push-ins, window slide-ins), pop for text in, chime for a green check, thud or click for impact or a card change.
- **[Bass hit on every key text pop](../topics/sound.md#sound-bass-hit-text-pop)** · sound: The L08 teaser lands impacts/bass drops on key text pops ("$100,000/MONTH", "WHY") and a metallic thud before the cut to black.
- **[Nothing linear](../topics/effects.md#fx-nothing-linear)** · effects: Nothing in the real world moves at constant speed; linear motion starts and stops all at once and looks robotic.
- **[Kinetic type: float-ins, glow, pop-ins](../topics/effects.md#fx-kinetic-words)** · effects: Spoken keywords float in as kinetic text (L07); the L08 teaser adds outer glow, chromatic aberration, scale pop-ins and tracked floating text with cubic-bezier easing.
- **[End on a thud and cut to black](../topics/transitions.md#tr-cut-to-black-thud)** · transitions: The teaser ends on a metallic thud and a hard cut to black.
- **[Script + heavy extruded sans pairing](../topics/text.md#text-script-plus-heavy-sans)** · text: Teaser pairing of a brush script with a heavy extruded/condensed bold sans (Futura Bold / Montserrat ExtraBold-like); palette red #FF0033, cyan #00CCFF, white, charcoal.
- **[Graphic teaser grade, natural body grade](../topics/colour.md#colour-teaser-vs-body)** · colour: L08's teaser has a high-contrast graphic look; the podcast body is warm and natural with saturated greens against warm skin.
- **[Talking-head light and lens looks](../topics/filming.md#film-talking-head-lighting)** · filming: Soft key front-left with a 35–50 mm wide-aperture look (L06); warm key with gold rim (L01); 20–24 mm wide for energy (L07); high-key soft 3-point with rim for a podcast (L08).
- **[Podcast set and a backdrop that teaches](../topics/filming.md#film-podcast-set)** · filming: Two people in ¾ profile, medium-wide, SM7B-style mics, acoustic panels and plants (L08); Harry hung printed favourite ads as the backdrop instead of putting everything on screen (L09).
- **[Talk to a photo of your best friend](../topics/filming.md#film-best-friend-behind-camera)** · filming: For camera nerves: prep fully then let go (The Inner Game of Tennis), and put a printed photo of your best friend behind the camera; decide later whether to post.
- **[Sacred hour at your best energy](../topics/filming.md#film-sacred-hour)** · filming: Block one fixed hour a day to record (Briar), at your best time of day (Caleb: mornings), and protect it like an important meeting.
- **[Brand = a title plus one emotion](../topics/brand.md#brand-title-one-emotion)** · brand: Tombstone test: what one title would people give you, and can they attach one emotion (Nike = hard work, New Balance = style)?
- **[Counter-position = different, not opposite](../topics/brand.md#brand-counter-position-different)** · brand: Counter-positioning means different positioning, not opposite; spike into a pocket, then grow out (Amazon with books, Vans with skaters).
- **[Small right audience beats big wrong one](../topics/brand.md#brand-follower-quality)** · brand: How and on what you grow is what your audience will always be; 10,000 quality followers can change your life. Caleb's 68K landscape-photo followers don't engage with his current topic.
- **[Weekly lead magnet into an owned list](../topics/growth.md#growth-lead-magnet-series)** · growth: One weekly lead-magnet CTA tied to a series ("comment data for my 5-day course"); email reaches ~100% vs under half of followers seeing a reel; Substack adds discovery (Briar's claims).
- **[Follower-first: ghost followers, non-follower %](../topics/growth.md#growth-follower-first-ghosts)** · growth: New posts go to followers first; off-topic followers scroll past and stall reach. Check non-follower view % on the last 5–10 posts: above ~50% is probably fine.
- **[Viral For You = 4–5× your baseline](../topics/growth.md#growth-viral-for-you)** · growth: Viral is relative: about 4–5× your own baseline (500 views → 2,000 is viral for you); then the baseline climbs.
- **[Growth timelines and 1% maths (claims)](../topics/growth.md#growth-one-percent-better)** · growth: Briar: 300 views + 1% a day ≈ 11,400 average views in a year. Oren: traction in 3–5 months of a pillar system. Caleb: 2–3 months of consistency = "top 1%". All their estimates.
- **[Untangle: hook, format, topic, illustration](../topics/growth.md#growth-untangle-data)** · growth: Split each week's videos into hook (psychological principle), format (visual form), topic (one word) and illustration (metaphor, story, stat, quote); test each part separately the next week.
- **[Weekly mix 4 : 2 : 1](../topics/growth.md#growth-weekly-4-2-1)** · growth: 4 top-of-funnel high-TAM posts with a through-line, 2 middle-of-funnel "blow their mind" blueprints, 1 bottom-of-funnel "sneak peek inside" (client journey, wins, community Q&A).
- **[Stories sell twice a week, nurture the rest](../topics/growth.md#growth-stories-nurture-sell)** · growth: Stories sell hard twice a week; the rest is life (runs, food, quotes). Stories are not a discovery mechanism.
- **[Series get the best view-to-follower ratio](../topics/growth.md#growth-series-view-to-follower)** · growth: Series ("day one of doing X") get the best view-to-follower ratio; days can be skipped, add value, blend in your expertise, raise the stakes, end with "follow along". Caleb: think like Netflix.
- **[Perfect is the enemy of posted](../topics/growth.md#growth-perfect-enemy-of-posted)** · growth: Don't withhold posts for the audience; start with a sustainable baseline (e.g. 1 YouTube video every 2 weeks + 3 shorts a week). Briar: sometimes just post (a camera-on, step-back clip got 14,000 views).
- **[Fast growers: no missed days, one line](../topics/growth.md#growth-tiktok-daily-ig-skip)** · growth: Fast growers stay on one line for a year and don't miss days on TikTok; Instagram tolerates skipping a bad day. Keep a bank of 14–15 videos.
- **[Follower ads and ad-only exposure hurt](../topics/growth.md#growth-paid-followers-hurt)** · growth: Bought followers (~$2 each) skip the first 3 s, dragging hook rate and watch time; people who only saw you in ads auto-scroll your posts.
- **[Trial Reels test hooks on non-followers](../topics/growth.md#growth-trial-reels)** · growth: Trial Reels (once 1,000+ followers) test hooks and variations with non-followers before followers see them; Briar names them as a growth tactic without explaining.
- **[Share the knowledge, sell the execution](../topics/business.md#biz-share-knowledge-sell-execution)** · business: Give the real frameworks, "not some teaser"; people realise execution is hard and pay for it. Briar gives away "the sauce": others take months to apply it.
- **[Follow up with "not now" people](../topics/business.md#biz-follow-up-not-now)** · business: Content is a mini follow-up; funnel = calls × show × close + follow-up closes. Their example: 100K views → $175K/month, $536K with better follow-up (unverified). Lowercase "quick question" email.
- **[Ads work better with organic presence](../topics/business.md#biz-ads-need-organic)** · business: Paid ads without an organic presence give poor return; closers close 10–15% higher when the prospect can see your content (claim).
- **[Cold outreach: Close Friends story + Loom](../topics/business.md#biz-close-friends-loom-dm)** · business: Empty Close Friends, add only targets, post a story naming them with a 3–5 min Loom pitch (Close Friends stories sit at the top of notifications); Substack DMs are uncrowded.
- **[Six pillars of content](../topics/process.md#proc-six-pillars)** · process: Strategy (state the goal in one sentence), ideation, scripting, talent/energy management (teleprompter, mornings, let a yapper talk 4–8 min), editing, growth tactics.
- **[AI for ideation, not scripting](../topics/ai-tools.md#ai-ideation-not-scripting)** · ai-tools: Briar: AI content in 2026 has nothing to do with scripting; use it for ideas (he allows AI scripting only for local-business clients).
- **[Confidence comes from evidence](../topics/process.md#mind-confidence-from-evidence)** · process: Confidence comes from evidence, evidence from effort. Niches make saturation not real: maybe three in a thousand actually put in the work.
- **[Results over ego](../topics/process.md#mind-results-over-ego)** · process: Don't let insecurity stop you posting; look at the metrics. Iteration over perfection: comfort doesn't build iconic brands. If friends on Instagram make you nervous, start on TikTok.
- **[Mentorship = speed](../topics/process.md#mind-mentorship-speed)** · process: Work for them or pay them, and ask short, specific questions; Briar spent 80% of his time for 20% of his income to learn in an agency.
